intro: Lithuania is a parliamentary republic with a directly elected president, and a member of NATO, the EU and the eurozone.

chapters.title: President and Seimas
text: The president is directly elected for five years and leads foreign policy. The parliament, the Seimas, has 141 members and approves the government.
Lithuania joined NATO and the EU in 2004. It built a gas import terminal named 'Independence' in 2014 to end its reliance on Russian gas.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The flag is yellow, green and red, and the coat of arms shows a knight on a white horse, called Vytis.
